Beach and rice field photoshoot with a groomed horse

1 hr - 1.5 hr · one person per horse · Bali · Run by Salty Cowboy

Overview

A static shoot for fashion, pre-wedding or personal sessions, along a 900m route through the rice fields to the beach. Time starts when you leave the stables. Out of respect for local culture, please no swimwear. Share your outfit plans with Simone beforehand.

FAQ

What's included in beach and rice field photoshoot with a groomed horse?

A beautifully groomed horse, Staff to help and assist you, The 900m walk through the village and along the rice fields to the beach.

How do I book?

Tap "Check dates with Salty Cowboy" below. You'll finish booking directly with Salty Cowboy, and Simone confirms your date on WhatsApp. No payment is taken on Threshold.

What are the start times?

Start times depend on the duration you choose. See the times table above, and note Salty Cowboy is closed Sundays and Saturday afternoons.

Can I add a photographer?

Yes. Add a Salty Cowboy photographer: +IDR 2,000,000 per hour, 20 edited images per hour.

What if I need to cancel?

Cancellation terms are set by Salty Cowboy. Ask them before you book.
